groups.title: Task 1 · Letter
groups.instructions: Write at least 150 words. Suggested time: 20 minutes.
groups.passage: You recently joined a local sports centre, but some of the facilities are unavailable. Write a letter to the manager. Describe which facilities you wanted to use, explain how the problem affects you, and suggest what the manager should do. Begin: Dear Sir or Madam,

groups.title: Task 2 · Lifelong learning
groups.instructions: Write at least 250 words. Suggested time: 40 minutes.
groups.passage: Some people think employers should provide training for their employees, while others believe people should pay for their own professional development. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
